newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MAN UTD TRIUMPH, LIVERPOOL LOSE TO LEICESTER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAN UTD TRIUMPH, LIVERPOOL LOSE TO LEICESTER.

text.p: Manchester United maintained their 100 percent record in the premier league on Wednesday on a bad night for Liverpool.

United, 2-0 winners at Tottenham last Sunday, beat Southampton 1-0 at Old Trafford with a David Beckham goal 12 minutes from the end but were overtaken in the standings by a rampant Blackburn who ripped apart Aston Villa 4-0 away thanks to a Chris Sutton hat-trick.
Paul Ince scored on his home league debut for Liverpool but it was not enough for the championship hopefuls.
They went down 2-1 to League Cup holders Leicester at Anfield after conceding the first goal after just 72 seconds and have now taken only one point from their two matches to date.

Les Ferdinand scored his first goal for Tottenham since joining from Newcastle but was a 2-1 loser at West Ham, leaving his club at the bottom of the table with two defeats while West Ham remained unbeaten.
Derby's first home match at their new Pride Park ground was far from proud. It was called off in the second half because of floodlight failure with the home team 2-1 up against Wimbledon.
